title: H6 fix round 1: the new acceptance and daemon tests leak module state into the rest of the suite (bus KeyErrors, worktree added inside the task worktree, merged_into KeyError); restore sandbox isolation so the full gate is green (gate_red on T-0359)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain d362503 (T-0359, H6) in git log; never drop or amend it.
Gate red on T-0359, reproduced on a clean external run of .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh (10 errors, deterministic, the base goal/T-0353 head is green):
ERROR test_bus.Bus.test_db_leaves_no_unclosed_connection, test_depends_on, test_lifecycle_and_rules, test_read_compact_rows, test_read_full_shape_unchanged: KeyError on the fixture's own task id (bus.get reads a different tasks dir than create_task wrote; ids differ per run, so a module global such as bus STATE/TASKS or spawn.ROOT is left patched by an earlier test).
ERROR test_cli.Cli.test_scorecard_table_and_json, test_status_plain_and_json: KeyError on a task id (same cause).
ERROR test_daemon.Daemon.test_ancestor_merged_task_skips_gate_and_review: KeyError 'merged_into' (the new gate path indexes a key that fixture tasks may lack; use .get).
ERROR test_merge.MergeQueue.test_checkout_ff_when_root_has_target_checked_out, test_checkout_stale_when_root_has_conflicting_local_change: RuntimeError git worktree add <task worktree>/wt/T-xxxx (spawn.ROOT or the harness ROOT points at the checked-out worktree instead of the sandbox, again leaked module state); plus one RuntimeError boom traceback from another test's thread.
Required: (1) tests/test_acceptance.py and the new tests in tests/test_daemon.py use the repository's per-test sandbox harness (tests/_harness.py, the same base class or fixtures the neighbouring tests use) and never patch bus, spawn, daemon or STATE globals without restoring them in tearDown or a context manager; no test may create tasks outside the sandbox; the acceptance module must not cache ROOT or STATE at import time. (2) daemon.gate's missing-tests branch reads task fields with .get and tolerates tasks without a worktree (skip the check, let the normal path run). (3) Run the suite twice in a row from the worktree root (.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . both times) and confirm exit 0 both times, then run only tests.test_bus and tests.test_merge after tests.test_acceptance and tests.test_daemon in one unittest invocation to prove ordering independence. Keep the five T-0359 acceptance tests green. git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows d362503 below your commit
python -m unittest tests.test_acceptance tests.test_daemon tests.test_bus tests.test_merge tests.test_cli in that order exits 0
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree on two consecutive runs

result.summary:
Summary: isolated acceptance/daemon tests from shared state and made gate skip acceptance-file checks when no worktree is present.

Files changed: `orchestrator/daemon.py`, `tests/test_acceptance.py`, `tests/test_daemon.py`

Commit: `abda0dc` (`d362503` is immediately below it)

Validation: ordered unittest invocation passed (152 tests); two consecutive gate runs completed successfully.

Failures-only test output: empty.
